title: Français 4696 — numerical cipher, ff54r–55r
contents: Intercepted letters disclose political loyalties in France. The Pope knows the cipher; the writer urges changing it, writing more cautiously to Italy, and sending the Duke of Mantua news of France by a secure route.
status: 3/3 pages transcribed; 1/3 pages deciphered; 2 more in part
fields: 70 codes: 49 letter signs, 19 in nomenclature, 2 unidentified
1,744 elements, 1,692 identified; 1 obscured group of unknown length

excerpt: **Piu sobria sara V.Ecc. nel scriuere in Italia, masime in modo che posi risapersi tanto. Sara meglio l’auuisare il serenisimo signor duca di Mantua frequentemente et per uia sicura de i sucesi di Francia. Sara sopra modo grato a S.A. a quale et a V.Ecc. tornara molto a conto.**
translation: The more restrained Your Excellency is in writing to Italy, especially in a way that could become known, the better. Informing the Most Serene Duke of Mantua frequently, and by a secure route, of events in France will be exceedingly welcome to His Highness and will greatly benefit both him and Your Excellency.
